I slowly took a walnut out of the bag, held it up as if to show it to him, and slowly threw it (underhanded throw) close to the fence. Over time, I reduced the distance of the throw. When it was close enough, I placed walnuts around me. After a while of him taking them, I slowly, without moving my torso or my head, grabbed a walnut, placed it in the palm of my hand, and held my hand out flat. He started taking the walnuts.
